description.value: Kerry Park Recreation Centre is a publicly operated multi-sport facility managed by the Cowichan Valley Regional District, situated on Shawnigan-Mill Bay Road in the Mill Bay area of Vancouver Island. As a regional recreation centre serving the surrounding Cowichan Valley communities, it offers a range of sports and fitness programming. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it a convenient stop, though specific cyclist-oriented amenities could not be confirmed from available sources.
